sources.name: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence website
sources.note: Organisation profile added 2026-09-14; classification and headquarters from the lab's own site.

profile_text.body:
The German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence, known as DFKI, is a nonprofit government lab headquartered in Kaiserslautern, Germany. On its own site the organization describes itself as recognized by the international scientific community as a major "Center of Excellence" in AI, and says it has focused on human-centric AI for more than 30 years, combining scientific excellence and commercially-oriented value creation with social awareness.

The site also notes a partnership between two leading AI research institutions intended to deepen scientific ties between Canada and Germany and advance trustworthy work, and a June 2026 item from Paris and Berlin describing cooperation between DFKI and the French National Institute for Research in Digital Science and Technology. Its latest magazine issue covers research questions around the perception, understanding, and agency of AI systems.

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the organization.
